VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims all 102 tests pass and describes reasonable technical work, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 102 tests pass"—a verifiable, objective requirement that demands attestable proof, not self-attestation.
